subject: Exclusive Summer Sale Event!
body: Dear valued customer, Get ready for summer with our exclusive sale event! Enjoy up to 50% off on selected items including swimwear, sunglasses, and beach accessories. Don't miss out on this limited-time offer to upgrade your summer wardrobe. Visit our store or shop online now to take advantage of these amazing deals. Hurry, before it's too late! Best regards, The Summer Style Team
